description: Navigate to the Fifteen Puzzle activity in GCompris (often found under the 'Discovery' or 'Strategy' category, icon showing a grid of numbered tiles). Open the activity and solve the puzzle by arranging the tiles in numerical order from 1 to 15 (left-to-right, top-to-bottom). Once solved, a congratulatory animation will appear. After solving it, take a screenshot of the solved state (or the success animation) and save it to '/home/ga/Documents/fifteen_puzzle_solved.png'.
